name.zh-Hant: 濟州火山島（漢拏山與城山日出峰）
name.zh-Hans: 济州火山岛（汉拿山与城山日出峰）
name.en: Jeju Volcanic Island (Hallasan and Seongsan Ilchulbong)

airspace.zh: 依韓國的規定，飛行高度150公尺以上須事先申請飛行核准，夜間禁止飛行，並應避免在人群上空飛行；申請透過「드론원스톱」民願服務（drone.onestop.go.kr）辦理。濟州島有機場，部分區域另有限制。實際飛行前請先確認最新規定。
airspace.en: Under Korean rules, flights at 150 m or higher need prior approval, night flights are prohibited and flying over crowds should be avoided; approvals are applied for through the Drone One-Stop service (drone.onestop.go.kr). Jeju has an airport, and some areas carry further restrictions. Check the current rules before any real flight.

tagline.zh-Hant: 三姓穴的傳說、1105年併入高麗、1653年的哈梅爾，到2007年的世界遺產
tagline.en: The Samseonghyeol legend, annexation in 1105, Hamel in 1653, and World Heritage in 2007

zh: 濟州島位在朝鮮半島南方約一百三十公里的海上。
這座島，從前是一個叫「耽羅」的王國。
en: Jeju lies some 130 km off the southern coast of the Korean Peninsula.
The island was once a kingdom called Tamna.

zh: 傳說耽羅的三位始祖高、梁、夫，從地上的三個洞穴走出來。
這三個洞穴叫「三姓穴」，至今保存在濟州市中心。
en: Legend says Tamna's three founders, Go, Yang and Bu, emerged from three holes in the ground.
Those holes, the Samseonghyeol, are still kept in the centre of Jeju City.

zh: 根據《三國史記》，耽羅在476年成為百濟的藩屬。
百濟衰落後，它轉向新羅稱臣。
en: According to the Samguk Sagi, Tamna became a tributary of Baekje in 476.
As Baekje declined, it turned to Silla instead.

zh: 938年，高麗征服了耽羅，1105年正式併入。
島上的自治一直保留到1404年的朝鮮時代。
en: Goryeo subjugated Tamna in 938 and formally annexed it in 1105.
The island kept local autonomy until 1404, under Joseon.

zh: 1274年，三別抄的抗爭在濟州島結束。
隨後的1275到1301年，這裡設為元朝的耽羅總管府。
en: In 1274 the Sambyeolcho rebellion came to its end on Jeju.
From 1275 to 1301 the island was administered by the Yuan as Tamna Prefecture.

zh: 城邑村在1423年、世宗在位時成為縣的官署所在地，
一直到1914年，都是行政中心。
en: Seongeup became a county seat in 1423, under King Sejong,
and remained an administrative centre until 1914.

zh: 這座有城牆的村子，已經有人住了大約六百年。
城牆保存完好，村裡還留著約一百一十棟建築。
en: People have lived in this walled village for about 600 years.
Its walls are well preserved, and about 110 structures remain.

zh: 1653年8月17日，荷蘭商船「雀鷹號」在島的西南外海觸礁。
包括哈梅爾在內，三十六人生還。
en: On 17 August 1653 the Dutch ship De Sperwer was wrecked off the island's south-west.
Hendrick Hamel was among the 36 survivors.

zh: 他們在朝鮮生活了十三年，1666年才逃到日本出島。
哈梅爾的遊記1668年出版，是西方人對朝鮮的第一份親身記錄。
en: They spent thirteen years in Korea before escaping to Dejima in Japan in 1666.
Hamel's journal, published in 1668, was the first Western first-hand account of Korea.

zh: 1966年，漢拏山海拔八百公尺以上劃為自然保護區，
列為天然紀念物第182號。
en: In 1966 the land above 800 metres on Hallasan became a nature reserve,
listed as Natural Monument No. 182.

zh: 1970年3月24日，漢拏山國家公園成立，
是韓國第九座國家公園，面積153平方公里。
en: Hallasan National Park was founded on 24 March 1970,
Korea's ninth national park, covering 153 square kilometres.

zh: 拒文岳在2005年指定為天然紀念物第444號。
2007年，它和漢拏山、城山日出峰一起列入世界遺產。
en: Geomunoreum became Natural Monument No. 444 in 2005.
In 2007 it joined Hallasan and Seongsan Ilchulbong on the World Heritage List.

zh: 2002年起，濟州是聯合國教科文組織的生物圈保護區，
2010年又成為世界地質公園。
en: Since 2002 Jeju has been a UNESCO biosphere reserve,
and in 2010 it became a UNESCO Global Geopark.

zh: 2020年起，登漢拏山要事先預約。
城板岳與觀音寺兩條步道，每天各限1,500人。
en: Since 2020 climbers on Hallasan have needed to book in advance.
The Seongpanak and Gwaneumsa trails are each limited to 1,500 people a day.

zh: 從耽羅的傳說、高麗與朝鮮，到國家公園與世界遺產，
漢拏山一直站在這段歷史的中央。
en: From the legend of Tamna through Goryeo and Joseon to a national park and World Heritage,
Hallasan has stood at the centre of this history.

title.en: Haenyeo, Stone Grandfathers and Black Walls

tagline.zh-Hant: 不帶氧氣筒下海的女性、守護城門的石像，以及兩萬多公里的田間石牆
tagline.en: Women who dive without air tanks, stone guardians at the gates, and twenty thousand km of field walls

zh: 濟州的海邊，有一群叫「海女」的女性潛水員。
她們不帶氧氣設備下海，有些人已經八十多歲。
en: Along the Jeju coast work women divers known as haenyeo.
They dive without breathing equipment, and some are in their eighties.

zh: 她們潛到約十公尺深，每次憋氣大約一分鐘。
一年約下海九十天，一天最長工作七小時。
en: They dive to about 10 metres, holding their breath for around a minute each time.
They work about 90 days a year, up to seven hours a day.

zh: 她們採的主要是鮑魚、海膽等貝類。
海女依經驗分成下軍、中軍、上軍，由上軍帶領。
en: They gather mainly shellfish such as abalone and sea urchins.
Divers are ranked hagun, junggun and sanggun; the most experienced, the sanggun, lead.

zh: 下水前，她們會祈求平安與豐收。
2016年，濟州海女文化列入人類非物質文化遺產。
en: Before diving they pray for safety and a good catch.
In 2016 the culture of Jeju haenyeo joined the Intangible Cultural Heritage list.

zh: 島上常見的石像，濟州話叫「石爺爺」。
1971年，這個稱呼成為官方名稱。
en: The stone statues seen all over the island are called dol hareubang, "stone grandfather".
In 1971 this became their official name.

zh: 石爺爺用火山岩雕成，從前成對立在城門前，
標示聚落的邊界，也守護城門。
en: Carved from volcanic stone, they once stood in pairs before fortress gates,
marking the edge of a settlement and guarding its entrance.

zh: 現存的古老石爺爺約有四十七、八尊。
濟州市有二十一尊，城邑村有十二尊。
en: Some 47 or 48 old statues survive.
Jeju City has 21 of them and Seongeup 12.

zh: 田地四周的黑色石牆叫「田墻」，
用島上的玄武岩乾砌而成，不用任何灰漿。
en: The black walls around the fields are called batdam,
stacked from the island's basalt without any mortar.

zh: 石牆故意留下縫隙，讓颱風的強風穿過去，
牆不會倒，還能當防風牆。
en: Gaps are left in the walls on purpose so typhoon winds can pass through;
the walls stay up and act as windbreaks.

zh: 有人估計，全島的田墻加起來約有兩萬兩千公里。
蜿蜒的模樣，被稱為「萬里黑龍」。
en: One estimate puts the field walls of the island at about 22,100 km.
Their winding lines have earned the name "ten-thousand-li black dragon".

zh: 每年元旦前後，城山日出峰舉行日出節。
太陽升起時，漁民會點亮漁船、鳴笛迎接。
en: Around New Year's Day, Seongsan Ilchulbong holds its Sunrise Festival.
As the sun comes up, fishermen light their boats and sound their whistles.

zh: 往漢拏山的城板岳步道長9.6公里，
單程約四個半小時，是最長的一條。
en: The Seongpanak trail up Hallasan is 9.6 km long,
about four and a half hours one way, the longest of them.

zh: 濟州市是濟州道的首府，人口將近五十萬。
濟州國際機場，是島上唯一的機場。
en: Jeju City is the provincial capital, home to nearly half a million people.
Jeju International Airport is the only airport on the island.

zh: 海女的呼吸聲、石爺爺的守望、黑石牆的線條，
是濟州人和火山島相處的方式。
en: The breath of the divers, the watch of the stone grandfathers, the lines of black walls:
these are how the people of Jeju live with a volcanic island.

title.zh-Hant: 一座山上的三個氣候帶

tagline.zh-Hant: 一千五百多種植物、韓國冷杉林、熔岩洞裡的生物，與海上的海豚
tagline.en: Over 1,500 plant species, Korean fir forest, life in the lava tubes, and dolphins at sea

zh: 濟州島記錄到1,565種維管束植物，
其中三十三種只生長在這座島上。
en: 1,565 species of vascular plants have been recorded on Jeju,
33 of them found only on this island.

zh: 從海邊到山頂，植被分成三個垂直帶：
亞熱帶、溫帶與寒帶。
en: From shore to summit the vegetation falls into three vertical belts:
subtropical, temperate and frigid.

zh: 漢拏山上有一千八百多種植物，
大約是韓國全部植物種類的一半。
en: Hallasan has more than 1,800 plant species,
about half of all Korea's species.

zh: 靠近山頂的坡地，長著韓國冷杉林，
還有北極與高山型的植物。
en: Near the summit grows a forest of Korean fir,
along with arctic-alpine plants.

zh: 山頂的火山口裡，有一座叫白鹿潭的火口湖。
湖的四周就是寒帶的植物。
en: In the summit crater lies a crater lake called Baengnokdam.
Around it grow the plants of the frigid belt.

zh: 拒文岳長滿濃密的松樹與杉樹林，
名字可能和林下陰暗的樣子有關。
en: Geomunoreum is covered in dense pine and cedar forest;
its name may come from the darkness under the trees.

zh: 熔岩洞的頂部與地面，覆蓋著多彩的碳酸鹽沉積，
像鐘乳石與石筍。
en: The roofs and floors of the lava tubes carry multicoloured carbonate deposits,
stalactites and stalagmites among them.

zh: 洞穴裡還住著稀有的洞穴蜘蛛。
龍泉洞的地下湖裡，有看不見的盲魚。
en: Rare cave spiders live in these caves.
The underground lake of Yongcheon Cave holds blind fish.

zh: 島上記錄到198種鳥類。
狍子和豹貓，是這裡受到保護的物種。
en: 198 bird species have been recorded on the island.
Siberian roe deer and leopard cats are among its endangered species.

zh: 外海住著印太瓶鼻海豚，
還有江豚的穩定族群。
en: Indo-Pacific bottlenose dolphins live off the coast,
along with resident finless porpoises.

zh: 遊客越來越多，造成踐踏與土壤侵蝕。
登山預約與人數上限，就是為了減輕這些壓力。
en: Rising visitor numbers bring trampling and erosion.
Trail bookings and daily caps are meant to ease that pressure.

zh: 濟州是唯一同時擁有世界遺產、生物圈保護區、
世界地質公園與拉姆薩濕地四種國際身分的地方。
en: Jeju is the only place holding four international designations at once:
World Heritage, biosphere reserve, Global Geopark and Ramsar site.

zh: 從海邊的亞熱帶到山頂的寒帶，
一座火山島，裝著好幾種氣候的生命。
en: From subtropical shores to a frigid summit,
one volcanic island holds the life of several climates.

tagline.zh-Hant: 盾狀火山漢拏山、三百六十座寄生火山、熔岩洞與海中的凝灰岩丘
tagline.en: The shield volcano Hallasan, 360 satellite cones, lava tubes and a tuff cone from the sea

zh: 濟州島面積1,846平方公里，是韓國最大的島。
整座島，都是火山噴發造出來的。
en: Jeju covers 1,846 square kilometres, the largest island in South Korea.
The whole island was built by volcanic eruptions.

zh: 島中央的漢拏山，海拔1,947公尺，是南韓最高峰。
它是一座盾狀火山，坡度平緩。
en: Hallasan at its centre, 1,947 metres high, is the highest peak in South Korea.
It is a shield volcano with gentle slopes.

zh: 盾狀火山由裂隙噴發的熔岩，一層層堆疊而成。
山頂的火山口裡，積成了白鹿潭。
en: A shield volcano grows from lava poured out of fissures, layer upon layer.
Its summit crater holds the lake of Baengnokdam.

zh: 山坡上散布著約三百六十座寄生火山，
濟州話叫「岳」，也就是小火山丘。
en: Some 360 satellite volcanoes are scattered over its slopes,
called oreum in the Jeju language.

zh: 大約一萬年前，海平面還很低，
濟州島最後一次和朝鮮半島相連。
en: About 10,000 years ago, when the sea stood lower,
Jeju was last joined to the Korean Peninsula.

zh: 拒文岳海拔456.6公尺，約在二、三十萬年前形成。
它的火口呈馬蹄形，向東北打開。
en: Geomunoreum, 456.6 metres high, formed some 200,000 to 300,000 years ago.
Its crater is horseshoe-shaped, open to the north-east.

zh: 火口裡的溝寬八十到一百五十公尺，
是地下熔岩管塌陷後留下的。
en: The trench in the crater, 80 to 150 metres wide,
formed where an underground lava tube collapsed.

zh: 熔岩從這裡往北北東流了約十三公里，一直流到海邊，
沿途留下一連串的熔岩洞。
en: Lava ran from here about 13 km north-north-east to the sea,
leaving a chain of lava tubes along the way.

zh: 萬丈窟長約8.9公里，
洞裡7.6公尺高的熔岩柱，是已知最大的一根。
en: Manjanggul is about 8.9 km long;
its 7.6-metre lava column is the largest known.

zh: 東端的城山日出峰，高182公尺，是一座凝灰岩丘。
它是岩漿在淺海碰到海水，猛烈噴發而成。
en: Seongsan Ilchulbong at the eastern tip, 182 metres high, is a tuff cone.
It formed when magma met seawater in a violent shallow-sea eruption.

zh: 它的岩壁幾乎垂直，從海裡直直升起，
是研究這類「蘇特西式」噴發的絕佳露頭。
en: Its walls rise almost vertically from the sea,
an outstanding exposure for studying Surtseyan eruptions.

zh: 它原本是一座離島，
後來泥沙堆積，才和濟州本島連在一起。
en: It was once a separate island;
later, sediment piled up and joined it to Jeju.

zh: 盾狀火山、寄生火山、熔岩洞與海中的凝灰岩丘：
濟州島，是一座把火山的各種樣子都攤開來的島。
en: Shield volcano, satellite cones, lava tubes and a tuff cone from the sea:
Jeju lays out the many forms a volcano can take.
